description: This file defines a React context (`DataContext`) and a provider component (`DataProvider`) that manage and cache application data related to users and sessions. It provides hooks and functions to load, refresh, and access this data throughout a React application.

methods.name: useDataContext()
methods.description: Custom React hook to access the shared DataContext, enabling components to consume the cached users and sessions data.

methods.name: DataProvider({ children })
methods.description: React component that initializes, caches, and provides access to users and sessions data. It loads data once at mount, handles loading and error states, and exposes refresh functions for manual data update.

methods.name: refreshUsers
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch and update the users list. It manages loading and error states accordingly.

methods.name: refreshSessions
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch and update the sessions list. It manages loading and error states accordingly.
